dog.description_text: Meet Reece! Reece is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. We don’t have much background information or many personality notes yet, but we’ll be updating their profile as we get to know them better. Every day reveals something new, and we’re excited to learn all the little quirks, preferences, and habits that make them unique. Her foster says "She is the cuddliest most loving dog ever. She always wants pets and will put her paw on your leg/hand when she wants more pets. She is very well behaved, a massive hit with all the people we've introduced her to, and guaranteed to make your life a lot better.". She is house trained, cuddly , playful, and gentle. She is energetic and social. Reece is a 1 1/2 year old female mixed breed dog who is about 41 pounds. She is spayed, microchipped, vaccinated, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
